## What about actual payment links?

There is an important distinction\:

| Metric | Available from these platforms? |
|--------|--------|
| New products launched weekly | (Yes) |
| Subscription prices | (Yes) |
| Free vs paid products | (Yes) |
| Checkout/payment URLs | Varies |
| Actual weekly transactions | (Generally no) |
| Actual Stripe revenue | (Generally no) |


These directories primarily track launches and publicly listed pricing, not private payment processor data.

## My recommendation

I'd combine SaaSearch and Launch Index\:

- SaaSearch for pricing, monetization and product discovery.
- Launch Index for weekly traction and launch performance.
- ScrollLaunch for indie founder and product trends.
